notes: The alternative on *Who* marks it `added` under rule 55; it is not taken because the participle is articleless and the supplied relative frame stays with the attributive itself (rule 41's closing sentence). Rule 46's anarthrous-substantive reading yields the same division and the same head on *giveth*, since no article morpheme is present either way.
*none* is given to the negative rather than treated as a supplied subject, since the negation is what the morpheme carries and nothing else in the clause answers to the word.
`אַיֵּה` is the predicate of the verbless clause and so carries the construction-supplied copula under rule 20, exactly as `מִי` does in *What man is this*.
